a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly leaves both of us dead. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me now.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said I would, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement. If no storm comes, the generator needs both of us, so I'll operate with you after this to rebuild the reserve for you.
